title: Nashville Annual Fourth of July Pub Crawl
includes: Stops at 4 to 5 unique watering holes!
Prizes for best outfit and game winners!
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Join us for our annual Firecracker Pub Crawl! This event will take place along historic Printers Alley and 2nd Avenue in downtown Nashville! Our world-class tour guides will take guests to five bars, each with exclusive drink specials just for Firecracker pub crawlers! All the while, guests will be entertained with patriotic-themed games, toasts, stories, and activities! Don't forget to wear your red, white, and blue! Prizes will be awarded for best outfit and game winners! Must be 21+
